summary: Frontend-focused E2E test of this round's new features on the public preview URL (1920x1080 desktop + 390x844 mobile spot-check). Verified: (1) home 'Team & wagenpark' section renders with both branded images actually loading (naturalWidth 1264 on team-image + van-image from static.prod-images.emergentagent.com) and the Realisaties gallery renders 7 tiles with ZERO broken images (page-wide broken-image scan returned []); (2) full 7-step wizard incl. the new 'Voorkeursdatum plaatsbezoek' date field (data-testid plaatsbezoek-datum, label 'Voorkeursdatum plaatsbezoek (optioneel)') -> submitted successfully and landed on /bedankt (now with footer, previous iteration's issue fixed); (3) admin login -> /admin with nav-marketing link; (4) lead detail PDF download: GET /api/admin/leads/{id}/pdf -> 200, real %PDF file, 3934 bytes, filename 'BetoDecor-aanvraag-Plaatsbezoek.pdf'; (5) email composer POST -> request made (502 for the @example.com address, EXPECTED), email history rendered with statuses ('verzonden'/'mislukt') and 'Bekijk' opened the correctly branded rendered email in a new tab; (6) Mailmarketing page: audience 'Alleen HOT' selected, POST /api/admin/campaign -> 200, 2 campaign entries appeared in campaign-history (status 'mislukt' for @example.com recipients, expected); (7) regressions: lang-fr/en/es all switch home copy, status-bezocht/nieuw PATCH -> 200 and persists across reload, logout returns to /admin/login. Only ONE real (minor) frontend bug found; everything else passes.

minor.issue: Returns 502 for undeliverable addresses which is correct, BUT the attempt IS already persisted to db.emails as type 'manual' status 'mislukt' before the raise. Consider returning 200 with {status:'mislukt'} (or 207) so clients can distinguish 'not logged' from 'logged but delivery failed' — this is what causes the UI issue below. Not blocking.

integration_issues.flow: Admin lead detail — email composer on delivery failure
integration_issues.issue: sendMail() only calls loadEmails() in the success branch; the catch branch just toasts. The backend already persisted the attempt as 'mislukt', so the 'Verzonden e-mails' list does NOT update after a failed send (verified: 2 entries before, 2 after, 3 after a manual page reload). Also subject/body are only cleared on success (acceptable) but the admin gets no visible record of the attempt. Fix: call loadEmails() in a finally block (or in catch).

issues: 'Voorkeur plaatsbezoek' shows the raw ISO value '2026-09-15' while every other date on the page uses fmtDate ('30 aug 2026'). Run it through fmtDate for consistency.

Both date inputs (plaatsbezoek-datum and deadline-date) use the native browser <input type=date> picker instead of a styled shadcn calendar; on desktop Chrome it renders as MM/DD/YYYY (US format) inside an otherwise Dutch/BE form. Cosmetic/locale inconsistency only — value is submitted correctly.

6 of the 7 gallery tiles are generic Unsplash/Pexels stock photos; only realisatie-1 uses a branded static.prod-images asset. Content note (not a defect): the section is titled 'Realisaties' (own realisations) so stock imagery is slightly misleading.

LeadDetail.jsx: format the 'Voorkeur plaatsbezoek' value with fmtDate instead of printing the raw ISO date.
Optional/cosmetic: replace the native date inputs in Wizard step 5 with the shadcn calendar for nl-BE date formatting.

Marketing.jsx send(): same pattern is handled better (loadRecent() after success) but a hard failure (non-200) also skips the refresh; campaign rows are per-recipient so a partial failure still refreshes only because the API returns 200.
Marketing.jsx: the 'Bekijk' button in campaign-history has no data-testid (the lead-detail equivalent has email-view-<id>); add campaign-view-<id> for testability.

Marketing.jsx viewEmail()/LeadDetail.jsx viewEmail(): window.open + document.write of server HTML is fine for admin-authored content, but will silently no-op when the popup blocker is active — no user feedback.
Carry-over from iteration 1 (still unfixed): login rate-limit key uses request.client.host (rotating ingress IP) so the 5-attempt lockout never triggers; CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True.

rca_of_the_issue: Email-history-not-refreshing RCA: backend POST /api/admin/leads/{id}/email calls _log_email(...) FIRST and only then raises HTTPException(502) on delivery failure, so the record exists. Frontend LeadDetail.jsx sendMail() places loadEmails() inside the try block after the await, so the 502 short-circuits to catch and the history state is never re-fetched. Reproduction: open a seeded lead (@example.com), send any email, observe error toast and unchanged email-history count; reload the page and the 'Handmatig / mislukt' entry appears. Fix: move loadEmails() to the finally block.
